title: Outbid boilerplate
excerpt: The outbid clone boilerplate. The pay-for-the-top-spot mechanic, Stripe, D1, and R2, live on Cloudflare with one wrangler command. $29 once, with immediate access via GitHub invite.
content_html:
1. outbid-directory.lol
  2. Outbid boilerplate

The outbid clone boilerplate.

The outbid mechanic, ready to reskin. Pay for the top spot, get outbid, price climbs. Built on TanStack Start with Stripe wired, and one wrangler command puts it live on Cloudflare.

One payment, no subscription. Pay, enter your GitHub username on the page that follows, then accept the repo invitation. The invite goes out the moment you submit the username.

Support is best effort: lars@confettisaas.com.

Deployed before your coffee is done.

Clone the repo and run pnpm quickstart. It asks for a brand name, an emoji, a domain, and your prices. Then it creates the D1 database and R2 bucket, runs the migrations, and deploys the worker to your own Cloudflare account. At the end it prints the live URL and a tokened admin link. Stop it any time and it picks up where you left off.

Stripe keys are the only manual step. Paste them when prompted, then add the webhook endpoint the script prints.

What ships in the box.

Not a demo. I pulled it out of this site's production code and trimmed it back to a starting point.

The outbid mechanic
Pay to take the top spot, get outbid, the price climbs. The loop that made outbid.lol viral, ready to reskin.

One command to Cloudflare
pnpm quickstart asks a few questions, then creates the database and bucket, migrates, and deploys. No servers, no Docker.

TanStack Start on Workers
SSR at the edge with file-based routes and server routes. The same stack this site runs on.

Stripe Checkout wired
Session creation, signed webhook verification, and replay-safe fulfilment, already wired.

D1 and R2 ready
Schema, numbered migrations, a payment idempotency ledger, and image caching with SSRF guards.

Admin, dark mode, analytics
Token-gated moderation page, system dark mode, and Umami events for submits and payments.

Want to see it running?

This directory is the boilerplate. The card grid, the checkout, the webhook, and the admin page all ship with it.

Browse the live directory
